# spatial-nav-css

> Spatial (directional) focus navigation for web UIs: arrow keys, gamepads, and
> TV remotes move real DOM focus to whatever is visually up, down, left, or
> right. Per-element behavior is declared in CSS custom properties or data
> attributes — no JS wiring per element. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT
> licensed, ESM + CJS, TypeScript types included. Inspired by Valve's Panorama
> UI and the W3C CSS Spatial Navigation Level 1 draft (not a polyfill).

Facts that matter when generating code against this library:

- Package name: `spatial-nav-css`. Core entry: `createSpatialNavigation(options)`
  returns `{ start, stop, destroy, navigate, focus, focusFirst, getFocused,
  activate, addAdapter, removeAdapter, engine }`. Call `start()` once at app
  mount; `import 'spatial-nav-css/css'` for the focus ring and `@property`
  registrations.
- Subpath exports: `/react` (SpatialNavigationProvider, useFocusable,
  SpatialContainer, useSpatialNavigation, useSpatialEvent), `/vue` (plugin +
  composables + directives), `/svelte` (store + actions), `/react-aria`
  (roving-tabindex interop), `/elements` (`<spatial-nav>` web components),
  `/virtual` (virtualized-list helper), `/dialogs` (spatialAlert /
  spatialConfirm), `/debug` (overlay), `/css` (stylesheet).
- Declarative config on elements: `--nav-up/-down/-left/-right: "<selector>" | none`
  (or `data-nav-*`) for explicit routes; `--spatial-container: contain wrap remember`
  (or `data-spatial-container`) for focus groups; `--spatial-default-focus: auto`
  (or `data-spatial-autofocus`) for a container's initial focus. Data
  attributes override the CSS forms and work without `@property` support.
- Anything matching the default focusable selector (links, enabled form
  controls, `[tabindex]`, media with controls, …) participates; add
  `data-focusable` to make a plain element a spatial stop.
- The engine emits bubbling, composed DOM CustomEvents: `spatial:beforefocus`
  (cancelable), `spatial:focus`, `spatial:nofocustarget`, `spatial:activate`
  (cancelable), `spatial:activaterelease` (`detail.durationMs` for
  long-press), `spatial:activatecancel`, `spatial:back` (cancelable).
  `detail` carries `{ direction, from, source }`.
- SSR-safe: `createSpatialNavigation()` returns a no-op facade when `document`
  is undefined; framework adapters render on the server without side effects.
- No-build usage: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/spatial-nav-css"></script>`
  loads `dist/spatial-nav.global.js` and exposes `window.SpatialNav` with the
  framework-free surface (core + elements + dialogs + virtual + debug).
- Node.js is only needed for repository tooling; the shipped library is
  ES2020 browser JavaScript.

## Docs

- [Guide](docs/guide.md): core concepts — engine, spatial CSS surface, input
  adapters; the mental model to read first
- [Spatial CSS reference](docs/css-api.md): every custom property and data
  attribute, precedence rules, inheritance and `@property` caveats
- [JS API reference](docs/js-api.md): createSpatialNavigation options,
  SpatialEngine, events, scoring tunables, focus restoration
- [Framework adapters](docs/frameworks.md): React, Vue, Svelte, react-aria,
  web components — idiomatic usage and caveats per framework
- [Input devices](docs/input-devices.md): keyboard/gamepad/remote adapters,
  keymaps, writing a custom InputAdapter (Steam Input, IR remotes)
- [Recipes](docs/recipes.md): copy-paste patterns — TV rails, launcher
  shells, modals, edge pagination, settings forms, grids, multi-region apps
- [Virtualization](docs/virtualization.md): keeping focus stable across
  windowed/recycled lists (TanStack Virtual and friends)
- [Performance](docs/performance.md): getComputedStyle cost model, budgets,
  and how to keep navigation O(visible candidates)
- [Edge cases](docs/edge-cases.md): documented behavior at the boundaries —
  geometry ties, zero-size rects, iframes, shadow DOM, disabled states
